history.russia-support.0040.all: Limited support. A shows popular support from land decree and also repression (closing SR newspaper by Red Guards); B shows terror by Cheka (arrests, executions). Agree on repression of opponents; differ in that A stresses popularity/land gains, B coercion. Provenance: peasant beneficiary vs Cheka official boasting. Judgement: partial support.

history.russia-support.0017.all: Little support. A: hunger, prices x4, casualties, discontent vs Tsar/Tsarina, riot risk. B: Brusilov success, shell production, nation united behind Tsar. Some overlap: both mention sacrifice/war burden (deaths vs sacrifices). Provenance: secret police report private/reliable vs propaganda army paper. Judgement: A largely contradicts B.

history.russia-support.0048.all: Largely contradicts. A: Whites advancing (Denikin 1919), Reds in disorder, popular welcome, foreign (British) aid. B: Reds control railways, Trotsky organisation, war communism grain requisition, Reds preferred to landlords/foreigners. Agree on foreign support for Whites. Different dates 1919 vs 1920 and perspectives (biased White ally vs worker). Judgement: limited support.
